description: Tool Search index for the Agent Knowledge Hub research workspace. Load this file first (~500 tokens), then fetch only the schemas you need from the paths listed here.

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Keyword search across research/concepts/ files. Returns ranked matches with file path, snippet, and matched keywords.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Keyword search across research/reports/ files. Returns ranked matches with file path, snippet, and matched keywords.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: Read a concept file in full by name (kebab slug or fuzzy match). Returns path and full markdown content.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read a report file in full by name (kebab slug or fuzzy match). Returns path and full markdown content.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Return TOPICS.md as structured JSON. Filter by status and/or type.

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: Compute the blast-radius priority tier for a set of keywords — how many existing concept/report files reference them.

tools.name: catalogue_concept
tools.description: Write or amend a concept entry in research/concepts/. Accepts structured content fields; handles file naming, README update, and TOPICS.md status update.

tools.name: write_report
tools.description: Write or amend a report in research/reports/. Accepts structured content fields; handles file naming, README update, and TOPICS.md status update.

tools.name: answer_charge
tools.description: Write or update a charge answer in research/charges/. Synthesises from existing concepts and reports — does not fetch external sources.
